name: Wichita
housing: Wichita renters mostly live in single-family houses and apartment complexes, with older homes and duplexes near the center and lofts in Old Town.

tenantHelp.name: Kansas Legal Services, Wichita office
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters

climate: Ask where to shelter in a tornado, test the heating and cooling, and photograph the roof and windows for hail damage.
fact: A Kansas Legal Services attorney says landlords not making repairs is the most common problem tenants bring to the office.
